full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white surreal collage presents a frontal human face beneath a crown of birds, leaves, and branching antlers. The background is a plain pale gray field, leaving the sharply cut head and shoulders isolated in the center. A dark jacket and white collar form a narrow formal base along the bottom edge. Above them, a softly shaded lower face remains visible: the nose, closed lips, chin, and cheeks are modeled in smooth photographic tones. The eyes and forehead disappear beneath a thick horizontal mass of flowers, leaves, and small ornamental shapes that spreads from temple to temple. At the upper center, a large dark bird faces right, its body rising above the floral mass. Branching antlers curve upward on either side behind it, making an open arch in the pale upper background. Dark winged forms extend outward near both sides of the head, one wing fanning broadly toward the right edge. Smaller botanical fragments and fine twigs fill the gaps between these larger silhouettes. The collage is not a seamless natural scene: finely engraved feathers and foliage meet the smooth tonal surface of the face with deliberate, visible changes in texture and scale. Dense black marks gather high in the frame, while the lower portrait keeps broad, quiet areas of gray. Light is even and frontal on the visible face, with subtle shading beneath the nose and lips; the clipped collage forms gain definition from crisp dark lines rather than a shared cast shadow. The overall composition uses a calm symmetrical portrait base and an unruly, dark ornamental crown to make a strange but balanced monochrome image.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白超现实拼贴画呈现一张正面的面孔，头顶被飞鸟、叶片和分枝鹿角构成的冠饰覆盖。背景是一整片浅灰色，让裁切清楚的头部与肩部孤立在中央。深色外套和白领在底边形成窄窄的正式基座。其上仍可看到柔和明暗塑造的下半张脸：鼻子、闭合的嘴唇、下巴和脸颊呈现平滑的摄影式调子。双眼与前额消失在一条从一侧太阳穴延伸到另一侧的厚密花叶与小装饰形体之下。上方中央，一只深色大鸟朝右，身躯从花丛上方升起。分枝鹿角在后面由两侧向上弯曲，在浅色上部背景中形成敞开的拱形。深色展翅形体从头部两侧向外伸出，其中一侧羽翼向右边缘宽阔展开。较小的植物碎片与细枝填满这些大剪影之间的空隙。拼贴并非无缝的自然场景：细密刻线的羽毛和枝叶与面部平滑的调子相遇，肌理和尺度的转换刻意可见。密集的黑色线迹聚在画面上方，而下方肖像保留宽阔安静的灰色区域。面部可见部分受均匀正面光照，鼻下与唇下有微弱阴影；裁切拼贴形主要依靠清晰暗线而非统一投影获得轮廓。整体构图用平静对称的肖像基座与不羁的深色装饰冠饰，形成奇异却平衡的单色画面。
style_prompt_en: This monochrome collage joins smoothly graded photographic tones to densely engraved marks and sharply clipped silhouettes. Fine black hatching describes intricate organic textures, while larger dark masses interrupt pale negative space with sudden graphic force. A compact, heavily worked upper area rests above a quieter lower zone, creating tension between ornamental abundance and restraint. Edges alternate between precise cut boundaries and fine feathered linework; overlapping fragments retain a deliberately assembled quality. Even diffuse light leaves the pale ground unobtrusive, so tonal contrast and changes in texture carry most of the depth. The result feels formal in its central balance and uncanny in its shifting scales.
style_prompt_zh: 这类单色拼贴把平滑渐层的摄影调子、密集的刻线和裁切鲜明的剪影结合起来。细黑排线描出复杂的有机肌理，较大的暗色块则以突然的图形力量切入浅色留白。紧凑而精工的上部区域压在较安静的下部之上，使装饰的丰盛与克制形成张力。边缘在精确裁切界线和羽毛般的细线间交替；交叠碎片保留刻意组装的特质。均匀漫射的光让浅色底面退后，纵深主要由明暗反差与肌理变化承担。结果在中央平衡中显得端正，在尺度转换中又透出奇异感。
theme_en: A monochrome face crowned by a dense collage of birds, foliage, and antlers
theme_zh: 一张被飞鸟、枝叶与鹿角密集拼贴遮覆的单色面孔
name: Dan Hillier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
